'''Suraile''' is an [[Aiel]] from the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]]. She is a [[Maiden of the Spear]]. Her father was [[Maeric]].

== Activities ==
When her clan begin to jump through a [[Gateway]] provided by "[[Sammael|Cadder]]", she stays in the rear guard position with the [[Stone Dog]] she is intending to marry. The Gateway suddenly snaps shut cutting her off from the rest of her clan.
